verdict.rationale: Vercel's docs say connecting GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket deploys on every push, with automatic preview environments and a preview URL for every branch. Previews get their own environment variables, access protection, and collaborator comments. The core of per-change preview deployments is clearly delivered, but the evidence speaks of branches and pushes rather than pull requests, and the full-stack part is only implied (Neon's instant branching is listed, but not shown wired to previews). Missing for 10: explicit per-pull-request preview wording, documented per-preview backend/database provisioning, ephemeral lifecycle/cleanup details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
